question: The term 'Panthalassa' is related to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oceans.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Panthalassa** refers to the** vast global ocean** that surrounded the **supercontinent Pangaea** during the **Paleozoic and Mesozoic eras.**
 
• The name comes from the Greek words **"pan" **meaning **all **and** "thalassa"** meaning** sea**.
 
• Panthalassa covered about** 70% of the Earth's surface** and was home to a diverse range of marine life.
 
• The breakup of **Pangaea** and the formation of modern continents caused the** oceanic basins** to expand and Panthalassa gradually disappeared.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Th**e atmosphere** refers to the **layer of gases** surrounding the Earth.

 
 
• About **78%** of the gases in Earth's atmosphere are** nitrogen, 21%** are **oxygen, **and **1% **are other gases.
 
 
 
• **Mountains** are **large landforms** that rise above the surrounding terrain.
 
 
• Typically, they have ridges that are** sharp or rounded, steep, sloping sides**, and a high point known as a **peak or summit.** 
 
 
 
• **Soil** is the mixture of **organic and inorganic **materials that support plant growth.
 
 
• They obtain their **nutrients and water **from the soil.
